To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the expression of auxin-related genes is involved in carbohydrate stress-induced fruit abscission.
the carbohydrate stress induced fruitlet drop in litchi is associated with the changes of auxin signal transducting genes expression.
carbohydrate stress induced fruitlet abortion in litchi is related to auxin signaling pathway.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanism of carbohydrate stress affecting fruit abscission, which will be helpful for the development of new strategies for fruit abscission regulation in litchi.
the expression of auxin-related genes in litchi fruit and their relationship with the regulation of auxin signal transducing pathway in the process of fruit abscission.
the molecular basis of auxin signal transducing in litchi fruit abscission.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

carbohydrate stress induces litchi frutilet abscission, which is regulated through auxin signal transductions, and the expression of LcAUS/IAA1 and LcGH3 is up-regulated, in contrast to LcARF, which is down-regulated.
the carbohydrate stress induced the fruitlet shedding by the reduction of IAA content, which in turn resulted in the transcriptional regulation of auxin-related genes.
the carbohydrate stress induced by girdling and defoliation treatment can affect fruitlet retention in Litchi by regulating the auxin-related genes expression in the abscission zone.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the carbohydrate stress could induce the expression of auxin-related genes in AZ of litchi frutilets, resulting in the increase of auxin level in AZ and the decrease of IAA in other tissues, which finally leads to the occurrence of litchi fruit abscission.

carbohydrate stress could induce litchi fruitelet abscission by reducing endogenous IAA levels, which is associated with the expression of genes related to auxin signal transductions, especially LcAUX1/IAA1 and LcGH3.

carbohydrate stress could affect the expression of genes related to auxin signal transductions in AZ and other tissues, and the expression of these genes may be associated with fruitlet shedding in litchi.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the expression of LcAUS/IAA1 was increased by carbohydrate stress, and it was negatively correlated with LcARF expression, which suggests that LcAUSIAA1 may play a role in regulating fruitlet drop in litchi.
auxin-related genes play an important role in the regulation of fruitlets abscission in response to carbohydrate stress.

the auxin signal pathway is involved in litchi fruitelet abscission induced carbohydrate stress, and the auxin-related genes (LcAIX/IAA1 and LcGH3) may be potential molecular markers for litchi frutelet abscission.
